info.description: BoltPe-owned Financial Planner APIs. Requests are validated before the internal Planning Engine runs. Goal timeline validation is strict: Instant goals require 6-12 months, Short goals 1-5 years, and Long goals 20-25 years. The timeline text must use the correct unit and match the numeric months/years field. Policy Planner is not used at runtime.
info.title: BoltPe Financial Planner API

post.description: Validates the request, runs the BoltPe-owned Planning Engine, persists the report and returns the report response. No Policy Planner/vendor call is used.

400.description: VAL_001 - validation failed, including Goal Master and timeline rules

500.description: BoltPe calculation, report generation, or storage error

post.description: Validates the request, creates the database audit row, runs the internal BoltPe Planning Engine, stores and returns structured JSON. After the JSON response is ready, PDF generation, S3 upload and email delivery continue in the background. Goal timeline validation is strict: Instant 6-12 Months; Short 1-5 Years; Long 20-25 Years; timeline text must match months/years. API-key and X-User-ID route validation are currently disabled in code.
post.summary: Generate structured BoltPe financial planner JSON

children_count.description: Required for Short, Long and Explorer flows; whole number >=0. Must be 0 for single customer and Instant-only flow.

contact.description: Required. Valid 10-digit Indian mobile number starting with 6-9.

dependents.description: Whole number >=0. Required for Explorer flow; must be 0/empty for Instant-only flow.

dob.description: Required. DD/MM/YYYY; calculated age must be 18-100.

education_1_target_age.description: Optional. 0/blank means omitted; otherwise whole number 1-100.

existing_critical.description: Insurance selection. Accepted: yes/no, true/false, 1/0. Not applicable for Instant-only flow.

existing_critical_cover.description: Cover amount. Must be >0 when corresponding insurance flag is selected; otherwise 0. Not applicable for Instant-only flow.

existing_health.description: Insurance selection. Accepted: yes/no, true/false, 1/0. Not applicable for Instant-only flow.

existing_health_cover.description: Cover amount. Must be >0 when corresponding insurance flag is selected; otherwise 0. Not applicable for Instant-only flow.

existing_life_term.description: Insurance selection. Accepted: yes/no, true/false, 1/0. Not applicable for Instant-only flow.

existing_life_term_cover.description: Cover amount. Must be >0 when corresponding insurance flag is selected; otherwise 0. Not applicable for Instant-only flow.

existing_personal.description: Insurance selection. Accepted: yes/no, true/false, 1/0. Not applicable for Instant-only flow.

existing_personal_cover.description: Cover amount. Must be >0 when corresponding insurance flag is selected; otherwise 0. Not applicable for Instant-only flow.

full_name.description: Required. 3-100 characters; letters, spaces, apostrophes, dots and hyphens only.

marital_status.description: Required for Short, Long and Explorer flows. Allowed: single, married. Must be empty for Instant-only flow.

marriage_1_target_age.description: Optional. 0/blank means omitted; otherwise whole number 1-100.

monthly_expenses.description: Required; numeric >=0, max 2 decimals, cannot exceed monthly_income.

monthly_savings.description: Required; numeric >=0, max 2 decimals; expenses + savings cannot exceed monthly_income.

risk_appetite.description: Required. Risk appetite used by the BoltPe allocation engine.

selected_goals_json.description: Required. At least one goal. Each key must be unique and must match the BoltPe Goal Master key, label, type and timeline rules.

spouse_dob.description: For married customers: required date in DD/MM/YYYY format. Calculated spouse age must be between 18 and 100. Must be empty when single.

child_1_name.description: Optional child name when children_count is at least 1.

child_1_dob.description: Optional child birthdate in DD/MM/YYYY format. Calculated age must be 0-25 and both parents must be at least 18 years older.

child_2_name.description: Optional child name when children_count is at least 2.

child_2_dob.description: Optional child birthdate in DD/MM/YYYY format. Calculated age must be 0-25 and both parents must be at least 18 years older.

spouse_income.description: For married customers: required numeric value >=0. Must be 0/empty when single.

message.example: Report email sent successfully to ravi@example.com.

amount.description: Required. Goal amount must be greater than 0.

categoryTitle.description: Display category. Example: Instant Goals, Short Term Goals, Long Term Goals.

key.description: BoltPe Goal Master key. Must be unique in selected_goals_json.

label.description: Must exactly match the selected Goal Master key label.

months.description: Instant: 6-12. Short/Long: must be 0/omitted. Must agree with timeline text.

timeline.description: Required display timeline and validated against type + numeric field. Instant: 6-12 Months and value must equal months. Short: 1-5 Years and value must equal years. Long: 20-25 Years and value must equal years. Wrong units, out-of-range values, or mismatches return HTTP 400 / VAL_001.

type.description: Must match the Goal Master type for the selected key.

years.description: Instant: must be 0/omitted. Short: 1-5. Long: 20-25. Must agree with timeline text.
